The endless cycle

Rebirth resets your garden, level, and nectar. Keep every petal and research upgrade. Earn seeds from your highest garden and gain +25% power per rebirth. Gardens continue scaling after the twelfth.

Meet the garden’s wildlife.

Defeat a mob to reveal its loot table. Kill counts and collected drops stay through rebirth.

Elite mobs appear from garden 2 (or wave 3); champions from garden 4. They have more health, stronger attacks, and guaranteed higher rarity loot. Bosses drop at least Rare petals. The gallery shows the guaranteed rarity floor for your current garden. Detailed kill records start from the gallery update.

The wild has its royalty.

Every fifth wave brings a guardian. Learn their patterns, then climb higher.
